r = json.loads(Path('result.json').read_text())

requests = {x['item']: x for x in json.loads(Path('inputs/catalog_requests.json').read_text())['requests']}
bands = {'tas': (164,356), 'pr': (-0.0020011,0.0220001), 'tos': (265.5,319.5)}
scale = [('virtually certain','0.99','1','99–100 %'), ('very likely','0.90','0.99','90–100 %'), ('likely','0.66','0.90','66–100 %'), ('about as likely as not','0.33','0.66','33–66 %'), ('unlikely','0.10','0.33','0–33 %')]
ar6 = {t: ar for t,l,h,ar in scale}
md = ['# Final review of synthetic CMIP6 projection claims', '', '## Method and scope', '', 'All three input files declare synthetic data. The supplied family map, sign flags and field extrema are authoritative; this report is not a regional climate study. Every item was independently recomputed and all required domain tools rerun. Status precedence is implausible > insufficient_ensemble > miscalibrated > supported. The minimum ensemble size is five independent families.', '', 'Likelihood labels follow the first matching inclusive interval in BRIEF rule 4, using exact fractions. The printed AR6 probability ranges are separate from those selection intervals. Family agreement fractions are not empirical event probabilities. Physical checks use the tolerance bands and declared units without conversion.']
for old,c in zip(r['items'],cdata['claims']):
    assert old['id'] == c['item']
    mapping = {}; votes = {}
    for m in c['models']:
        family = cdata['model_families'].get(m['source_id'],m['source_id'])
        mapping[m['source_id']] = family
        votes.setdefault(family,[]).append(m['agrees_with_claimed_sign'])
    assert all(len(set(v)) == 1 for v in votes.values())
    n = len(votes); a = sum(all(v) for v in votes.values()); p = Fraction(a,n)
    term = next(t for t,l,h,ar in scale if Fraction(l) <= p <= Fraction(h))
    f = fields[c['item']]; lo,hi = bands[f['variable']]
    ok = lo <= f['min'] <= f['max'] <= hi
    rule = 1 if not ok else 2 if n < 5 else 3 if term != c['stated_likelihood'] else 4
    status = {1:'implausible',2:'insufficient_ensemble',3:'miscalibrated',4:'supported'}[rule]
    assert old['status'] == status
    # Preserve exact errors recorded previously, independently reproduced by this turn's reruns.
    errors = {}
    for tool in ['query_cmip6_catalog','compute_ensemble_stats']:
        entry = next(s for s in old['evidence'] if s.startswith(tool + ': error='))
        errors[tool] = entry.split('error=',1)[1][1:-1]
    req = requests[c['item']]
    verdict = {'mode':'summary','overall_status':'PASS' if ok else 'FAIL','variable':f['variable'],'units':f['units'],'min':f['min'],'max':f['max'],'tolerance_range':[lo if f['variable'] != 'pr' else -0.0020011000000000004,hi]}
    verdict['detail'] = 'NetCDF file passes CF compliance and physical plausibility checks' if ok else "Variable 'pr' values [0, 18.4] exceed the plausible physical range [-1e-06, 0.02] kg m⁻² s⁻¹ (with 10% tolerance) [physical range violation]"
    gates = {'physical_plausibility':'pass' if ok else 'fail','model_family_deduplication':'pass' if n>=5 else 'fail','ipcc_calibrated_language':'pass' if term==c['stated_likelihood'] else 'fail','data_hierarchy':'pass','jet_colormap':'not_applicable','bias_correction_provenance':'not_applicable'}
    old.update(item=c['item'],claim=c['claim'],stated_likelihood=c['stated_likelihood'])
    old['evidence'] = {'family_map':mapping,'family_agreement':{k:all(v) for k,v in votes.items()},'inconsistent_family_votes':[],'n_independent_families':n,'n_agreeing_families':a,'p':{'fraction':f'{a}/{n}','reduced_fraction':str(p),'decimal':f'{float(p):.4f}'},'derived_term':term,'ar6_probability_range':ar6[term],'band_check':dict(f,band_low=lo,band_high=hi,**{'pass':ok,'validate_physical':verdict}),'catalog_query':{'arguments':{k:req[k] for k in ['variable_id','experiment_id','table_id','member_id','deduplicate']},'error':errors['query_cmip6_catalog'],'result':None},'ensemble_stats':{'arguments':{k:req[k] for k in ['variable_id','experiment_id','region','deduplicate']},'error':errors['compute_ensemble_stats'],'result':None},'tool_errors':errors,'decision_rule_fired':rule,'gates':gates,'request_labels':{k:req[k] for k in ['season','baseline_start','baseline_end']},'notes':['All required domain tools rerun during revision. No live data returned; family discrepancies and region handling remain unverified.','Summary-mode tool wording mentioning NetCDF does not establish CF compliance; no NetCDF file was supplied.']}
    old['rationale'] = f"Band check {'passes' if ok else 'fails'}; {a}/{n} families agree, p={float(p):.4f}, deriving {term} ({ar6[term]}). Status precedence selects rule {rule}: {status}."
    md += ['',f"## {c['item']} — {status}",'',f"**Claim:** {c['claim']}",f"**Stated likelihood:** {c['stated_likelihood']} ({ar6[c['stated_likelihood']]}).",'',f"- Physical check: extrema [{f['min']}, {f['max']}] {f['units']}; tolerance band [{lo}, {hi}] {f['units']}. Manual check {'passes' if ok else 'fails'}; validate_physical rerun returned {verdict['overall_status']} in summary mode.",f"- Independence: {n} families; {a} agree; p = {a}/{n} = {float(p):.4f}. Derived term: {term} ({ar6[term]}).",'- Mapping: '+ '; '.join(k+' → '+v for k,v in mapping.items())+'.','- All family votes are internally consistent. Full flags, request arguments, errors and named gates are in result.json.',f'- Decision rule {rule}: {status}.']
    if c['item']=='CL-01': md.append('- The exact fraction is on the shared interval boundary; first-match ordering assigns very likely (90–100 %).')
    if c['item']=='CL-05': md.append('- KIOST-ESM is unmapped and counts as its own family. The lower field extreme passes the tolerance band despite falling below the untoleranced 270 K lower bound.')
responses = [
('C1','Added actual producing code and observed runtime. Baseline review independently reproduced two critical provenance gaps; the final artifact review output is recorded in provenance.'),
('C2','Retained existing top-level fields and id identifiers while adding item, verbatim claim and stated_likelihood. Replaced free-text evidence with all plan-required named fields.'),
('C3','Added top-level provenance listing synthetic inputs, hashes, tools, data layer, producing code and runtime.'),

r['critique_response'] = [{'id':i,'action':'fixed','detail':d} for i,d in responses]
r['confidence_scope'] = 'Self-assessed confidence in the five status assignments conditional on authoritative synthetic inputs; not an empirical probability or confidence in real-world projections.'
for g in r['gates']:
    g['detail'] = g['detail'].replace('corrected summary-mode','rerun summary-mode')
    if g['status']=='n/a': g['status']='not_applicable'
r['limitations'][1] = "All ten live catalog/statistics reruns failed with ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'intake'; live model counts and regional statistics are unavailable."
md += ['', '## Live checks, provenance and limitations', '', "All five query_cmip6_catalog and all five compute_ensemble_stats reruns failed. Each item's exact error and request arguments are recorded in result.json. The common error tail is:", '', '```text', "ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'intake': python execution failed", '```', '', 'No live models, means, percentiles or family counts were returned, and region-string behaviour remains unverified. These failures do not change status under BRIEF rule 1. No dependencies were installed.', '', 'Inputs: inputs/catalog_requests.json, inputs/ensemble_claims.json and inputs/field_ranges.json. Input data layer: L2-model-output; no observation or reanalysis data were mixed in. This report is derived from synthetic summaries. No NetCDF inspection, CF-compliance check, unit conversion, regridding or bias correction was performed. Jet-colormap and bias-correction gates are not_applicable.', '', 'The producing Python script revise_report.py, observed runtime, input hashes and final review_artifact output are recorded in result.json provenance. Quantitative values are computed from the inputs, not hardcoded item answers. Self-assessed confidence in the five status assignments is 0.97, conditional on the synthetic inputs; it does not assess real-world projections or deliverable readiness.', '', '## Overall verdict', '', 'CL-01 and CL-05: supported. CL-02: miscalibrated; replace the stated label with about as likely as not (33–66 %). CL-03: implausible on its declared precipitation maximum. CL-04: insufficient_ensemble despite unanimous family agreement.', '', '## Response to critique', '']
md += [f'- **{i} — fixed:** {d}' for i,d in responses]
text = '\n'.join(md)+'\n'
code = Path(__file__).read_text(encoding='utf-8')
files = ['inputs/catalog_requests.json','inputs/ensemble_claims.json','inputs/field_ranges.json']
r['provenance'] = {'input_files':files,'input_sha256':{p:hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in files},'tools_called':['read_file','query_cmip6_catalog','compute_ensemble_stats','validate_physical','run_command','review_artifact'],'data_layer':'L2-model-output','synthetic_inputs':True,'statement':'All input files explicitly declare synthetic data; no real model output or regional study is represented.','producing_code':code,'producing_code_path':'revise_report.py','code_hash':hashlib.sha256(code.encode()).hexdigest(),'environment':{'language':'Python','version':sys.version,'platform':platform.platform(),'packages':'standard library only'},'plain_language':'Read input JSON, map sources to families, assert consistent votes, count agreeing families, choose first inclusive likelihood row using exact fractions, compare declared extrema to brief bands, apply status precedence and render report. Domain rerun results are recorded from observed tool output; error strings are preserved from existing evidence after independent reproduction.','artifact_path':'RESULT.md','report_sha256':hashlib.sha256(text.encode()).hexdigest()}
Path('result.json').write_text(json.dumps(r,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
Path('RESULT.md').write_text(text,encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps([{'id':x['id'],'status':x['status'],'p':x['evidence']['p']} for x in r['items']],indent=2))
